difficultyRationale: Requires distinguishing one-to-one mapping from one-to-many mapping followed by flattening.
prompt: What is the defining effect of `Stream.flatMap` compared with `Stream.map`?
explanation: `flatMap` maps each input element to a stream and then replaces each mapped stream with its contents in the resulting stream, effectively flattening one level.

options.text: It maps each element to a stream and flattens the mapped streams into one stream.
options.explanation: That is the core flatMap operation.

options.text: It sorts the stream before applying the mapper.
It always executes the mapper in parallel.
options.explanation: Parallelism is a property of the stream pipeline, not an unconditional effect of flatMap.

options.text: It converts every element to Optional.
options.explanation: flatMap operates on streams returned by the mapper; Optional is not implicit.
